google_oauth_disclosure_body: Gmail can send only messages you compose; it cannot read your mailbox. Google Contacts reads names, email addresses, and phone numbers for recipient autocomplete; contact photos are not requested and the Prism AAC directory. Prism AAC refreshes every five minutes while signed in and may keep up to 200 Google-derived contacts in local browser or device storage. Google-derived contacts are removed after a confirmed Google disconnect or authoritative successful sync; manual contacts and contacts from other providers remain. Synalux never writes to Google Contacts. Google API data is not sent to generative AI, advertising, profiling, or model training.
